name: GitHub
notes: Signs in through the browser on first use; a personal access token in an Authorization header works instead.

name: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence)
notes: OAuth 2.1 with the person's own Atlassian permissions; an API token is optional.

name: Linear
notes: A read-only variant answers at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp/readonly.

name: Sentry
notes: Append /<organization>/<project> to the URL to scope the server to one project.

name: Playwright browser
notes: The box has no browser of its own: add --cdp-endpoint http://<host-ip>:9222 to drive the host Chrome. npx downloads the server into the bot's home volume on first use.
